predicate.Path.detail: Match requests by URL path pattern. Supports Spring Ant-style patterns: ? (single char), * (any chars except /), ** (any chars including /). Example: /api/** matches all paths under /api/.
predicate.Host.detail: Match requests by Host header. Supports Ant-style patterns like *.example.com to match all subdomains. Useful for multi-tenant routing based on domain.
predicate.Method.detail: Match requests by HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS). Supports multiple methods. Useful for API method restrictions.
predicate.Header.detail: Match requests by HTTP header presence or value. Supports regular expressions for value matching. Example: X-Request-Id matches header presence, X-Request-Id=\d+ matches header value pattern.
